AI Apocalypse Fears Drive Tech Stock Declines Amid Cyber Threat Warnings

Fears of an AI-driven apocalypse are increasingly mainstream, contributing to a significant decline in tech stocks. Experts are warning that artificial intelligence is exponentially increasing cyber threats. This sentiment has permeated discussions, with warnings about AI's potential negative impacts gaining wider traction. The situation highlights growing concerns about the rapid advancement of AI technology and its potential societal and economic ramifications.
